basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 29-year-old DIY enthusiast living in Cincinnati, Ohio. I recently bought a fixer-upper and have been diving into home improvement projects headfirst. I work as a graphic designer during the day and spend my evenings learning about various renovation techniques online. Usually, I browse Reddit in the evenings between 7 PM and 10 PM EST. I'm single, and when I'm not working on my house, I enjoy watching TV shows like Hannibal and catching the Reds games. Occasionally, I look for side gigs on platforms like 'beermoneyglobal' to fund my projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a graphic design degree, which gives me a creative edge in visualizing home improvement projects. Most of my home renovation knowledge comes from self-study and hands-on experience. I've been learning through online forums, YouTube tutorials, and engaging with communities on Reddit.
